summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class (prologue as a list of per-operation prologues, algebra as the list of translated operations). (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) which sets _original_args; processUpdate and SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update now accept a prepared Update as well as a string. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (4) New test file test/test_sparql_prepareupdate.py covers return type, applying to a graph, reuse across graphs, and initNs handling. Tests were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading the code only. Nothing committed. Docs and changelog not updated.
